questions.prompt: The swan sings before it dies.
questions.answer: Cycnus canit antequam moritur.

questions.prompt: You reply before I finish the question.
questions.answer: Prius respondēs quam rogātiōnem cōnficiō.

questions.prompt: The greedy man counts his coins before the sun rises.
questions.answer: Avārus nummōs numerat antequam sōl oritur.

questions.prompt: The plague creeps through the city before the doctors arrive.
questions.answer: Pestis per urbem serpit antequam medicī adveniunt.

questions.prompt: I will say nothing before he has spoken.
questions.answer: Nihil dīcam priusquam ille dīxerit.

questions.prompt: We will not set out before the general has given the signal.
questions.answer: Nōn proficīscēmur priusquam dux signum dederit.

questions.prompt: You will understand the danger before the enemy has crossed the river.
questions.answer: Perīculum intellegēs antequam hostis flūmen trānsierit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers will not rest before they have captured the citadel.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs nōn quiēscent priusquam arcem cēperint.

questions.prompt: There was no end of slaughter before the tyrant satisfied his men with wealth.
questions.answer: Nōn prius caedis fīnis fuit quam tyrannus suōs dīvitiīs explēvit.

questions.prompt: He did not flee before he had seen the enemy's camp.
questions.answer: Nōn prius fūgit quam hostium castra vīdit.

questions.prompt: The fire did not halt before it had consumed the whole forest.
questions.answer: Ignis nōn ante cōnstitit quam tōtam silvam absūmpsit.

questions.prompt: We did not sleep before the watchmen returned.
questions.answer: Nōn prius dormīvimus quam vigilēs rediērunt.

questions.prompt: The frightened citizens flee before the flames touch the walls.
questions.answer: Cīvēs territī fugiunt antequam flammae mūrōs tangunt.

questions.prompt: Before the messenger arrives, the king already knows the outcome.
questions.answer: Antequam nūntius advenit, rēx iam ēventum scit.

questions.prompt: The wise man deliberates before he acts.
questions.answer: Sapiēns dēlīberat antequam agit.

questions.prompt: You praise the poem before you have read it in full.
questions.answer: Carmen laudās antequam tōtum lēgistī.

questions.prompt: Before the sun has set, we will reach the harbor.
questions.answer: Antequam sōl occiderit, portum attingēmus.

questions.prompt: I will not believe the rumor before I have heard it with my own ears.
questions.answer: Nōn rūmōrī crēdam priusquam meīs auribus audīverō.

questions.prompt: The farmer will sow the seeds before winter has come.
questions.answer: Agricola sēmina seret antequam hiems vēnerit.

questions.prompt: You will not take the city before you have crossed the mountains.
questions.answer: Urbem nōn capiēs priusquam montēs superāveris.

questions.prompt: The exhausted traveler did not rest before he had reached the inn.
questions.answer: Fessus viātor nōn prius quiēvit quam ad dēversōrium pervēnit.

questions.prompt: There was no peace before the consul drove out the traitors.
questions.answer: Nōn ante pāx fuit quam cōnsul prōditōrēs expulit.

questions.prompt: The child did not stop crying before its mother returned.
questions.answer: Puer nōn prius flēre dēstitit quam māter rediit.

questions.prompt: The sailors did not draw in the sails before the storm broke.
questions.answer: Nautae vēla nōn prius contrāxērunt quam tempestās coorta est.

questions.prompt: Nor did he let him go until he gave a pledge.
questions.answer: Neque ante dīmīsit eum quam fidem dedit.

questions.prompt: Cato himself by this time had rather be a slave than fight.
questions.answer: Catō ipse iam servīre quam pūgnāre māvult.

questions.prompt: Nor did they stop running until they reached the river.
questions.answer: Neque prius fugere dēstitērunt quam ad flūmen pervēnērunt.

questions.prompt: Before you could sell him his own property, he took possession of it himself.
questions.answer: Priusquam tū suum sibi vēnderēs, ipse possēdit.

questions.prompt: Before a weapon could be thrown or our men approached nearer, the whole line about Varus took flight.
questions.answer: Priusquam tēlum abicī posset aut nostrī propius accēderent, omnis Vārī aciēs terga vertit.

questions.prompt: Before I reply to the rest, I will say a little about friendship.
questions.answer: Priusquam dē cēterīs rēbus respondeō, dē amīcitiā pauca dīcam.

questions.prompt: I shall not weary till I have traced out their doubtful ways.
questions.answer: Nōn dēfatīgābor antequam illōrum ancipitēs viās percēperō.
